first.rationale: The current onboarding and activation declines align directly with prior evidence that shorter onboarding and fewer signup requirements improved completion, time-to-value, and durable early activation. Verify those records before launching a controlled experiment. Do not prioritize promotional pricing despite competitor pressure because inherited evidence indicates material 30-day retention harm, which conflicts with sustainable qualified revenue.

final.rationale: Run a targeted simplification experiment for SMB/simple-workspace accounts, excluding complex workspaces. The verified evidence shows higher onboarding completion, faster time-to-value, improved activation, and qualified-revenue lift in the target segment. Monitor retention and qualified revenue as guardrails because shortened onboarding increased 60-day churn in complex workspaces and signup simplification showed a small 30-day retention decline. Avoid reacting to competitor pricing with discounts because prior evidence found material retention harm.
